agent.final_message:
I wrote both proposed statements, `P7.HabitatThreshold` and `P7.SpeciesArea`. Both compile, and none of the simple tactics I tried (`norm_num`, `simp`, `aesop`, `decide`, `grind`, `positivity`, `linarith`) closes either one. Neither is claimed as proved, and `run.json` has no claims.

**Frontier duty (M-Nucleation): no test plan proposed.** The closest public data I found is the Zahawi et al. 2013 applied-nucleation experiment (Zenodo record 4731126); I looked only at its file list. It counts new trees recruiting around planted islands of three sizes. It doesn't record whether planted clusters grew or shrank, and that is what the premise predicts: clusters below a critical size shrink. More recruits on bigger islands has many possible explanations, so this data couldn't contradict the premise in particular. `notes.md` says why and names a follow-up Holl-lab dataset (Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.s7h44j1gc) to check next session. I haven't confirmed that it measures island growth.

**The two statements:**
- **`P7.HabitatThreshold`** has the five parts from the spec, with `growth` and `pstar` defined in its own namespace. The rationale says it is about the sign of the growth term, not about solutions of the differential equation, and that `c`, `e`, `h` are field inputs.
- **`P7.SpeciesArea`** has the four parts using real powers, written as plain `a ^ z` to match the spec. The rationale says `S = k·A^z` is assumed, that `k` cancels, and that the statement says nothing about extinction debt, which species are lost, where the remaining habitat lies, or any value of `z`.
- **Checks in each module:** the specified witnesses and negative controls, plus one extra control of my own: `e = 0` breaks part 5. The brief asked for `decide`, but it can't evaluate real numbers, so I used `norm_num` and said so in the rationales.
- **Hand checks:** each "check before proposing" note is worked through in the matching `.md` file.

**Truth check.** I wrote full Lean proofs of both exact statements in a scratch folder outside `out/` (`/tmp/scratch`). That was only to make sure I wasn't proposing something false; it isn't in the package. One thing it turned up that the proof task will need: in the pinned Mathlib, `Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge` requires a strictly positive base. The `a = 0` and `s = 0` cases need the primed version, `Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge'`. Proof sketches for P7-T002 and P7-T003 are in `notes.md` and `run.json`.

**Two choices left for Justin when sealing:**
- `HabitatThreshold` doesn't require `p ≤ 1` or `h ≤ 1`, because the algebra doesn't need them.
- `SpeciesArea` part 3 keeps `z ≤ 1` as the spec has it, though that part holds for any `z ≥ 0`.

**Paper and references.** The paper (`paper/main.tex`) starts the project. It includes both statements as listings, a table of the checks, limitations and a changelog, and it compiles with `latexmk -pdf`. All five references were checked against Crossref. My first DOI for Lande 1987 was wrong and is corrected (10.1086/284734). No Aristotle jobs were pending from earlier runs, and none were submitted tonight.

Files are in `out/`:
- `run.json`
- `notes.md`
- `paper/main.tex`
- `paper/refs.bib`
- `proposals/P7.HabitatThreshold.lean`
- `proposals/P7.HabitatThreshold.md`
- `proposals/P7.SpeciesArea.lean`
- `proposals/P7.SpeciesArea.md`

Sources:
- [Zahawi et al. 2013 data (Zenodo)](https://zenodo.org/records/4731126)
- [Zahawi et al. 2013, J. Appl. Ecol.](https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/1365-2664.12014)
- [Holl lab follow-up dataset (Dryad)](https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.s7h44j1gc)
